audit.title: Customer PWA functional audit
audit.evidenceLayer: static source inspection plus executable source-contract tests

gaps.title: Wrong-host login creates a valid session before tenant/customer rejection
gaps.currentBehavior: Login accepts global Supabase credentials; customer tenant binding happens later via getMyCustomerIdentity.
gaps.risk: A valid user can hold a confusing session on a tenant host where they have no customer link.
gaps.recommendedChange: Define and enforce a host-bound login contract before or immediately after session creation.
missingTests: API or browser runtime test for valid credentials on the wrong tenant host
API or browser runtime test for valid cookie on the wrong tenant host

gaps.title: Multiple customer_users rows for one auth user are resolved by first row
gaps.currentBehavior: Identity query uses .limit(1) without ordering, selection, or ambiguity failure.
gaps.risk: A customer user linked to more than one customer in the same tenant can receive arbitrary customer context.
gaps.recommendedChange: Choose one supported product model: unique active customer context per auth user per tenant, or explicit customer context selection.
missingTests: Static and database integration test for same auth user linked to two customers in one tenant
Runtime test for duplicate unclaimed invite claim behavior

gaps.title: Feature module-off behavior is UI-only for several customer PWA surfaces
gaps.currentBehavior: customer_portal is server-gated, but finance, documents, reporting, quotes, payments, and PDFs are not consistently gated in server actions/routes.
gaps.risk: Direct URLs or server actions can expose data while a feature module is disabled.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require module entitlements server-side for every feature action, API route, and page loader.
missingTests: Contract and runtime tests for disabled finance, reporting, documents, notifications, help, and releases modules
Direct route and server-action denial tests

gaps.title: Backoffice assignment mutations can create object/customer mismatches
gaps.currentBehavior: Customer assignment requests validate object/customer/tenant, but backoffice assignment create/update paths need equivalent object/customer/tenant consistency checks.
gaps.risk: A stale or forged backoffice form can attach an assignment to an object from another customer or tenant.
gaps.recommendedChange: Reject object/customer/tenant mismatches at the backoffice mutation boundary and consider database constraints.
missingTests: Server-action runtime test for cross-customer object id in assignment create/update
Database integration test for assignment object/customer/tenant consistency

gaps.title: Quote approval sets assignment to plannable, not scheduled
gaps.currentBehavior: approveQuote updates the quote to approved and the assignment to plannable.
gaps.risk: Customer-facing status can be misleading if product expects scheduled immediately after approval.
gaps.recommendedChange: Clarify product contract, then either document plannable as correct or change the workflow in a future implementation PR.
missingTests: Lifecycle test for quote sent, approve, expected next assignment status, schedule, and customer status display

gaps.title: Payment initiation lacks finance/payment-settings enforcement and server-side idempotency
gaps.currentBehavior: Customer payment actions check invoice ownership and status, then create Mollie payments without finance module or tenant payment-setting checks.
gaps.risk: Disabled payment features can still create provider payments; duplicate clicks can create duplicate provider payments.
gaps.recommendedChange: Check finance entitlement, tenant payment settings, and introduce provider/local idempotency before creating Mollie payments.
missingTests: Runtime test for finance module disabled
Runtime test for Mollie disabled
Concurrent duplicate-click/payment idempotency test

gaps.title: Batch payment local persistence may fail after provider checkout creation
gaps.currentBehavior: Batch payments insert a payment row with invoice_id null; older tenant trigger resolves tenant from invoice_id.
gaps.risk: A provider checkout can be created before local payment persistence fails, creating an orphan provider payment.
gaps.recommendedChange: Update batch-payment trigger compatibility in a future migration and make provider creation recoverable.
missingTests: Database integration test for invoice_collection payment with invoice_id null
Provider orphan recovery test

gaps.title: Webhook reconciliation trusts local Mollie id without metadata tenant/customer comparison
gaps.currentBehavior: Webhook refetches Mollie status, then updates local records by molliePaymentId; unsigned calls are accepted if webhook secret is absent.
gaps.risk: Provider metadata mismatch and orphan payment cases are not durable recovery events.
gaps.recommendedChange: Require webhook verification outside local dev, compare provider metadata to local tenant/customer/invoice, and persist orphan reconciliation events.
missingTests: API runtime test for metadata mismatch
API runtime test for orphan provider payment
Signature-required test for production-like configuration

gaps.title: Customer-origin ticket events do not name recipients and are not audited
gaps.currentBehavior: Ticket create/reply are tenant/customer scoped but emit management events with no recipients and audit false.
gaps.risk: Backoffice may not receive reliable in-app/email/push notification and ticket activity is less auditable.
gaps.recommendedChange: Define management recipients for customer-origin ticket events and audit ticket create/reply/close/reopen.
missingTests: Notification queue/runtime test for customer-created ticket
Audit contract test for ticket actions

gaps.title: Customer notification preferences are saved but not consumed by emitDomainEvent
gaps.currentBehavior: Preferences are stored in customer_portal_preferences, while emitDomainEvent queues based on event settings and recipient contact data.
gaps.risk: Customer opt-outs may not affect operational email or push delivery.
gaps.recommendedChange: Either document preferences as UI-only or enforce them in the central notification emitter.
missingTests: Notification delivery contract for opted-out customer preferences
Audit contract for preference changes

gaps.title: Approved media/report visibility relies on parent-scope contracts and static tests
gaps.currentBehavior: Customer assignment detail signs only approved photos and reports only approved report content, but runtime Storage/RLS proof is absent.
gaps.risk: Future child routes could bypass parent authorization; report content may contain internal prose if review process is not explicit.
gaps.recommendedChange: Add runtime Storage/RLS tests and consider a separate customer-visible report summary field.
missingTests: Storage runtime test for unapproved and cross-tenant photo paths
Report approval/browser test for customer-visible content only
